answer: Time-locked staking stops bulk fakes at the dawn of onboarding. First, each identity locks 150 units for 20 epochs, releasing 5% per honest epoch, so capital cannot roll on. Then, the lagoon of locked funds stays frozen while VRF spot-checks demand work proofs; a missed check resets the timer and slashes 60%. Finally, the fable of cheap clones breaks on cost: 1,000 clones lock 150,000 units, 30% caught lose 27,000, and the lock kills turnover.
